code_set_disclosure: Historical Reference Version: Uses ICD-10-CM FY2024 and CPT 2024 Educational Reference Subsets. Does not represent current FY2026/FY2027 annual coding updates.

standard_citations.missing_diagnosis_support: ICD-10-CM Official Guidelines for Coding and Reporting FY 2024, Section I.B.1: The importance of consistent, complete documentation in the medical record cannot be overemphasized. Conditions not documented in the medical record by the provider must not be assigned.
standard_citations.code_diagnosis_mismatch: ICD-10-CM Official Guidelines for Coding and Reporting FY 2024, Section I.A.19: Code assignment is based on the documentation by the attending healthcare provider.
standard_citations.unspecified_code_usage: ICD-10-CM Official Guidelines for Coding and Reporting FY 2024, Section I.B.18: Sign/symptom/unspecified codes should be reported when a more specific diagnosis cannot be made. When a specific diagnosis is documented, the specific code must be selected.
standard_citations.duplicate_diagnosis: CMS Medicare Claims Processing Manual (Pub. 100-04) Chapter 23 §10: Guidelines on Fee Schedule Administration; duplicate or redundant diagnostic lines for the same encounter create claim adjudication rejections and scrub errors.
standard_citations.unsupported_procedure: Social Security Act §1862(a)(1)(A) & CMS Medicare Benefit Policy Manual (Pub. 100-02) Chapter 15 §20: No payment may be made for expenses incurred for items or services which are not reasonable and necessary for the diagnosis or treatment of illness or injury.
standard_citations.missing_procedure_documentation: CMS Medicare Program Integrity Manual (Pub. 100-08) Chapter 3 §3.3.2.4 & AMA CPT Instructions: Every reported procedural CPT code must be supported by an authentic operative or diagnostic procedure report.
standard_citations.incomplete_clinical_notes: Medicare Program Integrity Manual (Pub. 100-08) Chapter 3 §3.3.2.4: Medical documentation must contain sufficient clinical detail to support the level of care and medical necessity billed.
standard_citations.missing_provider_signature: CMS Medicare Learning Network (MLN) Matters Article MM6698: Signature Guidelines for Medical Review; medical record documentation requires a valid handwritten or compliant electronic signature by the authoring clinician.
standard_citations.high_level_em_underdocumented: AMA CPT 2024 E/M Guidelines & CMS 2021/2023 Outpatient E/M Documentation Revisions: Level 5 office visits (99215/99205) require either high-complexity Medical Decision Making (MDM) or documented total encounter time (40-54 minutes for 99215).
standard_citations.unverified_code_manual_check: ICD-10-CM Official Guidelines Section I.A.19 & AMA CPT Instructions: Reported diagnostic and procedural codes must be verified against current official tabular indices before claim generation.

severity_definitions.High: Potential compliance audit failure, overpayment risk, or critical medical necessity deficiency requiring mandatory human auditor review before claim submission.
severity_definitions.Medium: Documentation gap, missing element, or potential coding query candidate requiring review and possible provider addendum.
severity_definitions.Low: Informational coding optimization, unspecified code warning, or minor administrative discrepancy.
